exposure: longitudinal dissection of the uterus in the midline
cohort: Seven patients with diffuse uterine leiomyomatosis
finding: The novel myomectomy technique for diffuse uterine leiomyomatosis was successful in removing a large number of myomas, improving anemia, and allowing for successful pregnancies in some cases.
mod_finding: Two out of three pregnancies after the procedure resulted in cesarean sections after a normal course of pregnancy and birth of healthy babies.
